body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds independently implemented source-command and axiom-log parsers for PR236, complementing Will Richards's PR746 without importing or executing the original parsers.

The audit confirms all 3,606 source command lists, 7,253 dependency edges, 14,320 recorded declarations, six theorem mirrors, and eight pinned scientific inputs.

This is an independent recorded-evidence verification. It does not claim a new κ, does not change the selected frontier, and does not constitute a fresh Lean kernel build. Compiler and `.olean` bytes remain unavailable and are explicitly recorded as trust-boundary limitations.

## Validation

The complete report check passes both normally and under Python `-O`.

The contribution adds 22 focused regression and corruption-control tests, all of which pass in both modes. Existing selected-result verification, 549-PR reconciliation, and 14 reconciliation regression tests also pass.

Reproduction:

```sh
python3 -B research/pr236-independent-command-audit/verify.py --fetch --check research/pr236-independent-command-audit/REPORT.json
python3 -O -B research/pr236-independent-command-audit/verify.py --check research/pr236-independent-command-audit/REPORT.json
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_pr236_independent_command_audit.py -v
python3 -O -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_pr236_independent_command_audit.py -v
python3 -B scripts/verify_selected_result.py
python3 -B scripts/verify_pr_reconciliation.py
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_pr_reconciliation.py -v
```

Corruption controls cover repaired outer hashes, modified source commands, malformed evidence, dependency inconsistencies, and object-digest trust boundaries.

Credits: James Chang for PR236, Douglas Colkitt's maintainer audit, Will Richards for PR746, and the original paired-cube contributors.

Prepared for WeberChen8128 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
title: Independently audit PR236 source commands and recorded axiom evidence
